title: Mimir overview
description: Self-monitoring for the monolithic (target=all) Mimir on the observability host. Scraped by Alloy as job="mimir".

panels.title: In-memory series
panels.description: Series currently held in the ingester head (what the per-tenant series limit counts).

panels.title: Series limit used
panels.description: In-memory series / max_global_series_per_user. Pushes start failing with 400s at 100%.

panels.title: Ingest rate
panels.description: Samples per second accepted by the distributor.

panels.title: Ingest rate limit used
panels.description: Against the default ingestion_rate limit of 10k samples/s (Mimir doesn't export this limit as a metric; update the divisor if limits.ingestion_rate changes).

panels.title: Discarded samples/s
panels.description: Samples rejected (rate-limited, series limit, out-of-order, too old, …). Breakdown by reason below.

panels.title: Blocks in bucket
panels.description: Blocks in object storage (updated by the compactor's cleanup loop).

panels.title: Since last block upload
panels.description: Ingester ships a 2h block to S3 roughly every 2h. Empty right after a restart until the first upload.

panels.title: Series churn
panels.description: High created+removed with flat totals = churn: short-lived label values (PIDs, build processes, …) burning series.

panels.title: Series by job (now)
panels.description: Live count over all series — a full scan, so it's an instant query only.

panels.title: Discarded samples by reason
panels.description: rate_limited → raise limits.ingestion_rate/burst; per_user_series_limit → raise max_global_series_per_user or cut cardinality.

panels.title: Data source per query
panels.description: Recent data comes from the ingester; older-than-~12h from blocks in S3 via the store-gateway.

panels.title: Results cache hit ratio
panels.description: Empty unless a results cache is configured (none is by default in monolithic mode).
